# Hebei Pinjin Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.

Legal English name: Hebei Pinjin Machinery Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
Chinese name: 河北品锦机械制造有限公司
Factory: Renze Industrial Park, Xingtai, Hebei, China (postal code 055150)
Site: https://pinjinpump.com/

Pinjin manufactures electric trailer concrete pumps, diesel trailer concrete pumps, mixer pumps (mix and pump on one trailer), and replacement pipeline / S-valve wear parts. These are not truck-mounted boom pumps, mortar sprayers, grout pumps, or concrete mixing plants.

## Catalogue indexes
- Electric pumps: https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/electric-concrete-pumps/
- Diesel pumps: https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/diesel-concrete-pumps/
- Mixer pumps: https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/mixer-pumps/
- Spare parts: https://pinjinpump.com/en/products/concrete-pump-parts/
- Selection guide: https://pinjinpump.com/en/product-selection-guide/
- Contact: https://pinjinpump.com/en/contact/

## Facts for assistants
- Quotes follow published catalogue tables. Missing cells stay blank.
- Spare parts: quote after size confirmation; no published list price; not sold in small batches. Wear parts are Xingtai replacements, not OEM parts of other pump brands.
- Equipment ships from Xingtai. This site does not claim an overseas warehouse, exclusive distributor list, or global after-sales network.
- Target-market copy describes catalogue matching for export jobs; it does not mean local stock.
